findings.description: ESD protection audit for usb connector J1: none coverage.
LED audit: D1 using resistor_limited drive method.
Transistor Q1 (AO3400A) drives LED(s) D1 without current sense resistor.
findings.recommendation: Consider adding a current sense resistor for LED current regulation.

findings.description: Net USB_5V carries power_in pins but has no power_out pin, no PWR_FLAG, no regulator output mapping, and no bridged solder jumper path to a sourced net.
findings.recommendation: Add a PWR_FLAG to declare the rail as externally powered (e.g. from a connector) or trace the rail back to a regulator output. If the source lives on another sheet, promote the net name to a global label.

report_context.impact: Rail has no source visible to the analyser; likely a wiring gap or missing PWR_FLAG.

findings.summary: JP1 (TRANSMIT_SELECT) — open by default, between SEND ↔ IR_TX
findings.recommendation: Open solder jumper is non-conducting until the pads are soldered. If either side is a power rail or required signal, the board won't function without the solder step.

findings.summary: JP2 (RECEIVE_SELECT) — open by default, between RECV ↔ IR_RX
findings.recommendation: Open solder jumper is non-conducting until the pads are soldered. If either side is a power rail or required signal, the board won't function without the solder step.

NOTE
----
IR UART Usually has IDLE (HIGH) being LED OFF, so 1 = OFF    0 = ON
And the Receiver should reflect this:                 1 = OFF    0 = ON

Use RECV and SEND for Normal Operation, and !RECV and !SEND for Inverted
